scope: Independently review imported per-cascade terrain caster culling, retain the useful work-elimination finding with conservative bounds, direct full-caster depth/image oracles, lifecycle tests, and scoped same-tree performance evidence. No new renderer or simulation behavior.

supplied_claims.assessment: Not accepted as demonstrated game-FPS or production-frame results. A real large isolated redraw saving is independently confirmed below, but old split/unified comparisons share the same culling and do not establish culling correctness. No demonstrated mismatch in the supplied endpoints is claimed.

implementation.bounds: Canonical curved tile sphere: sqrt(2)*radius*half_extent + decoded absolute height envelope + f32 reconstruction allowance. Uses the full signed residual encoding range and scale, not sampled source extrema. Unknown/custom/invalid or extreme-scale bounds fail open.
implementation.culling: Six homogeneous clip planes from the actual GPU f32 matrix promoted to f64. Camera-relative sphere and float-dot-product allowances. No camera-frustum culling; off-camera casters remain eligible. Coalesce contiguous accepted slots without a transient visible-list Vec.
implementation.lifecycle: Bounds allocated only for shadow-enabled slot capacity. Dirty successful uploads/publications update bounds, retired slots clear them; rejected inputs preserve state. Existing depth cache retained. No additional GPU buffers, passes, quality reduction or production toggle.
implementation.fallback: All ocean-enabled terrain submits original full caster coverage until spectral deformation bounds share this lifecycle. Mesh casters unchanged.
implementation.diagnostics: Last-actual-depth candidate/submitted slot and draw-call counters; zero on cache hits/disabled. Diagnostic full-caster encoder and explicit raw all-layer Depth32Float readback; no ordinary-frame readback. Atlas COPY_SRC usage added without extra GPU storage.
implementation.allocation_boundary: No global allocator instrumentation, zero-copy or global zero-allocation claim. wgpu/queue/driver, streaming and UI behavior not inferred from range coalescing.

environment.hardware: AMD Radeon 880M Graphics (RADV STRIX1), Linux/Vulkan; same local iGPU as the prior pipeline review
environment.measurement_conditions: Sequential GPU jobs; no competing agent build/test jobs during measured blocks. GPU/CPU clocks, thermal state and desktop activity not locked. Tests do not start an audio-bearing application.

measurement.scope: full_versus_culled_shadow_cost only: same-tree full/culled caster selection. Other tests in this command also reran prior split/unified diagnostics and HDR correctness; they are not the full/cull baseline.
measurement.requested_atlas_size_note: Fixture requests 256 but capability/settings resolution clamps to 512; report actual storage, not requested dimensions.
measurement.GPU_scope: depth atlas / remaining scene commands, hardware timestamps; queue writes excluded
measurement.wall_scope: CPU update + encoding + queue submission + GPU completion; excludes timestamp readback, endpoint atlas/color readback, streaming, source publication and compilation
measurement.oracle: All eight block endpoints per scenario have byte-identical full/cull depth atlas AND final RGBA. Static path uses the existing exact cache after warmup; moving path changes origin identically each block.

static.interpretation: About 0.12% central difference, not an established static improvement. Exact cache reuse already avoids caster work.

moving.interpretation: Strong isolated same-workload redraw saving, despite visible within-run drift and more draw calls. Aggregate values are medians of four per-mode block medians, not pooled frame percentiles. Not a +330% game-FPS, production-ocean, UI, loading, simulation or complete-renderer replacement result.

backend_ignored_lib.scope: Two real-adapter tests: generated bounds/disabled allocation and unchanged-origin cache; one debug CPU serialization diagnostic, not a release performance claim.

native_ignored_bin.audio: ALSA null config plus invalid Pulse/PipeWire remotes, as in prior capture runs

final_lifecycle_release.scope: Rerun after empty-range draw skip and stronger height-replacement fixture that visibly enters an initially excluded light-depth volume.

verification.boundary: All named jobs completed successfully on this machine. Broad-suite ignored counts are not reported as executed; separate named ignored jobs above did run. The measured release run preceded only the no-op empty-terrain draw skip, stronger correctness fixtures and documentation; no nonempty benchmark path changed afterward. No remote-green-CI or published commit is implied.
